pos:TE2:DST7.title: Spend the next roster move on defense
pos:TE2:DST7.text: Target a defense off the wire before the next bye hits. Yours ranks seventh of eight teams while your tight ends sit second, so that's the gap actually costing you points. Your tight ends didn't sign up to carry the defense too.

proj:under:4567104:4360761.title: Your kicker is outperforming your receiver
proj:under:4567104:4360761.text: Fix the receiver spot before you fix your faith in projections. Will Reichard keeps beating his; Michael Wilson keeps missing his. ESPN's model trusts Wilson more than your own eyes should.

lineup:B:4259545:w1.title: One bad call, way back in Week 1
lineup:B:4259545:w1.text: Keep trusting your gut here, it's worked. Your only real lineup regret all season came in Week 1, when Emeka Egbuka got the flex over D'Andre Swift, who torched everyone from your bench instead. Consider it long forgiven.

proj:over:4567048:4360248.title: Kenneth Walker keeps making ESPN look silly
proj:over:4567048:4360248.text: The tight end problem has a name, and it isn't Walker. Kenneth Walker III has outrun his projection all season; Kyle Pitts Sr. hasn't come close to his in weeks.

lineup:C:4241416:w1.title: Chuba Hubbard made the bench the better lineup
lineup:C:4241416:w1.text: Trust the bench over the flex call next time it's this close. Week 1 is the only real bruise on an otherwise clean season: Jaylen Waddle got the flex nod while Chuba Hubbard went off from the bench instead.

pos:K1:QB8.title: The upgrade isn't at kicker, it's the other position
pos:K1:QB8.text: Your quarterbacks are the thinnest position on this roster, while your kicker leads the league, and given this season's quarterback history, nobody's shocked.

proj:under:4595348:4572680.title: Malik Nabers is outplaying his own hype
proj:under:4595348:4572680.text: Nabers earned his spot; Kraft is still auditioning for his. Malik Nabers keeps clearing his projection like it's a layup. Tucker Kraft can't say the same.

pos:TE1:RB8.title: Fix running back first, before anything else
pos:TE1:RB8.text: It's the worst group in the league, while your tight ends are the best, which tracks given how often the flex has gone to the wrong back.

proj:under:4248528:3929630.title: Christian Watson keeps making the bench call look worse
proj:under:4248528:3929630.text: The flex spot keeps betting on the wrong back. Christian Watson has outplayed his projection for weeks; Saquon Barkley keeps coming up empty against his.

lineup:C:4432665:w3.title: Brock Bowers earned a permanent apology
lineup:C:4432665:w3.text: Owe Brock Bowers an apology and start him next time. Week 3's miss: Dalton Schultz got the tight end start while Bowers had a big day from the bench instead.

pos:QB2:K7.title: The kicker is the only bill left to pay
pos:QB2:K7.text: The cheapest fix on this roster is at kicker. It's the one position actually dragging the team down, while quarterback carries it, second in the league.

proj:under:4685472:4685382.title: McMillan is having the better season and ESPN missed it
proj:under:4685472:4685382.text: If the flex spot's been a coin flip, the coin already told you which way to land. McMillan keeps topping his projection, week after week; Hampton keeps undershooting his.

lineup:B:4431459:w5.title: Your one bench regret, and it's a small one
lineup:B:4431459:w5.text: Keep the bench this honest and the dings stay rare. Week 5's only real miss: Harold Fannin Jr. got the tight end nod while Tyler Warren outproduced him from the bench, the lone smudge on an otherwise clean record.

proj:over:4429795:4870795.title: Jahmyr Gibbs doesn't read his own projection
proj:over:4429795:4870795.text: If there's a running back problem on this roster, it isn't Gibbs. He keeps beating what ESPN expects of him, start to finish, while Makai Lemon has missed his more often than not.

lineup:C:4431299:w4.title: Rashee Rice gave you nothing, literally
lineup:C:4431299:w4.text: Don't make the same read twice. Week 4: Rashee Rice started at receiver and gave you a complete blank, while Rome Odunze produced from the bench instead.

pos:QB1:WR8.title: Your quarterback is covering for your receivers
pos:QB1:WR8.text: Make the next roster move at receiver, before quarterback ends up carrying this team alone. It's the best room you've got; receiver is the worst.

lineup:C:15847:w2.title: Travis Kelce had a day, and you missed it
lineup:C:15847:w2.text: The Swifties still haven't forgiven this one, so don't repeat it. Week 2: Dallas Goedert got the tight end start while Travis Kelce had one of his better games from the bench instead.
